summary: Full backend+frontend validation of the new Caracas TZ / rates / delete-my-entry / weekly-report-done batch. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_batch_caracas.py (12 tests) plus ran the existing suite → 35 passed / 2 legacy skipped. Verified: (a) GET /api/me/dashboard exposes now with -04:00 offset, today_date matches Caracas date, week.start is the current Wednesday; (b) POST /api/entries with date=<future> → 400 ('No puedes reportar un día que aún no ha llegado'), date=<prev week> → 400, past day of current week → 200 and stored with correct date + created_at, duplicate → 409; (c) DELETE /api/entries/{id} for current-week entry → {deleted:true}, prev-week entry inserted via Mongo → 400 'Solo puedes borrar reportes de la semana en curso', other user's entry → 404, unknown id → 404; (d) GET /api/admin/rates returns {current,week_start,history}; PUT with 5.0/0.35 persists with current week_start, dashboard.rates and estimate.kgen reflect new rate (hours×5); negative rejected 400; restored to 4.0/0.30; (e) POST /api/me/weekly-report-done returns {done: prev_ws} and dashboard weekly_report.done flips to true. Frontend (viewport 420px, current Caracas time 21 Sep 2026 23:2x): logged in as temp worker TmpUI (code 3344). Verified my-weekly-rank / my-global-rank do NOT exist; daily-countdown visible with HH:MM:SS (00:30:32); 7 entry-day-YYYY-MM-DD buttons (Mié 16 → Mar 22); tomorrow (2026-09-22) disabled; clicking Dom 20 sept updates submit-minutes-button text to 'Enviar reporte de Dom 20 sept'; submitted with employee-minutes-input + PNG upload → day shows 75m + entry appears in list with my-entry-uploaded-<id> text 'Subido: 21-sept., 11:30 p. m.'; my-entry-delete-<id> visible only for current-week entries, delete-confirm flow removes the entry. employee-kgen-card shows amount (hours × kgen_rate); employee-balance-card text contains '(estimado)' when <10h. goal-section, goal-progress-bar, goal-progress-label ("Faltan 10 h 0 min · 0%"), daily-quote and daily-quote-author present; quote is deterministic across reload (same text after page.reload). earnings-chart initial title 'Pagos de KGEN' data-view=kgen; clicking earnings-next → 'Pagos del BONO' data-view=bonus. employee-weekly-ranking-name-1 has NO 'fire' class (class attr = null). Admin flow: rates-card renders; rates-save-button disabled with no changes, enabled after edit; changed KGEN to 4.5, toast 'Tarifas actualizadas para esta semana en adelante', persists after reload (input shows 4.5), then restored to 4.0/0.30. Registros mobile tab: entry rows show entry-uploaded-<id> with 'Subido: 21-sept., 11:27 p. m.' format. Semana tab loads with weekly line chart. /api/admin/payments/export → 200 (curl). Cleanup done: deleted TmpUI worker, tarifas back to defaults, pytest TEST_* workers auto-cleaned by fixtures.
critical_code_review_comments: Recharts throws 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on the earnings-chart when first mounted at 420px width — non-blocking, chart renders fine after layout settles, but consider giving the ResponsiveContainer a fixed aspect or minHeight to silence the warnings.

server.py delete_my_entry validates target date is in the current Caracas week (good), but note it uses today_local() at delete time; if a member deletes at Caracas 23:59 vs 00:01 across the Tue→Wed boundary they'll see different results. Documented for future consideration, not a defect for this batch.
rates_for_week returns kgen_rate/bonus_rate as float via cast, but PUT stores round(..., 4). Consider validating a sane upper bound (e.g., < 100) to prevent typos like 40 vs 4.0.

Weekly window Wed 2026-09-16 → Tue 2026-09-22. daily-countdown is visible only when Caracas hour >= 18 and no report today; weekly-report-notice only fires Wed >= 12:00 Caracas when prev week > 300 min — in this run the API path was validated (weekly_report.due/done fields on dashboard) rather than the UI banner. Login is via numeric keypad (pin-key-<digit>), not a text input. payment-calendar-grid lives on the member page (EmployeePage), not the admin Semana tab.
